usg.text: The Tolarian Academy was founded by Urza and Barrin on the island of Tolaria, admitting only children and gathering talented scholars including Teferi.
At the Academy Urza creates Karn by implanting Xantcha's heartstone in a silver golem, and Teferi creates Teferi's Drakes, which Barrin uses to defend the university against Kerrick's forces.

The time machine then fails catastrophically after Karn is sent back to prevent a Phyrexian invasion, destroying most of the Academy, killing hundreds and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.
Urza rebuilds the Academy and uses its temporal rifts for fast-time research.

ulg.text: In Urza's Legacy, Urza creates the Metathran army, with Barrin contesting his methods and researchers quitting.

While Urza is away, the people of the Tolarian Academy battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island, and Barrin saves Urza as Multani, trapped within him, later helps destroy Kerrick and his Negators during the Invasion of Tolaria.
